_note: The town as a place (design/08 section 3, Brent 2026-10-18: 'the town needs to not be a menu'). Built by scripts/town_builder.gd. Coordinates are the level's frame: origin at the middle of the square, x east, z south, metres. size: the walkable square. walls: wall height per side (the camera looks from the south-east, so south and east are low). exits: gaps in a side wall; 'at' is measured along that side from the middle; walk_through exits fire when you walk into the gateway (within exit_reach of its middle); the others are a shut door you use with the interact key; 'action' is the main.gd method called. arrive: where you stand when you come into town from each place. folk: one person per service; 'role' picks what talking to them offers (ui/talk_screen.gd); 'outfit' are item ids worn (data/wardrobe.json maps them to clothes); 'face' is the way they look when nobody is near. props: city kit props [kind, x, z, yaw degrees]. look_seed keeps the people looking the same every visit. talk_reach: how close you must stand to talk; leave_reach: walk further than this from the person you are talking to and the panel closes. stations (design/12): crafting stations as places - id (a data/crafting.json station), at, yaw, solid [x, z] metres of collider; a person with a 'station' works that station (ui/talk_screen.gd offers its crafting). Names, lines and layout are ours [MODEL].

exits.name: the arena gate
exits.prompt: The practice arena. Walk through - it is free, and what you kill leaves something to sell.

exits.name: the Dross Gate
exits.prompt: The Dross Gate. Walk through, out into the Stubble - no ticket, no rent.

folk.name: Sister Aud
folk.title: healer
folk.line: Sit. Tell me where it hurts, and I will tell you what it costs.

folk.name: Haskel Brandt
folk.title: merchant
folk.line: Everything on the board is for sale, and everything you carry has a price.

folk.name: Morrow Pell
folk.title: innkeeper
folk.line: A bed, a lock on the door, and a book with your name in it.

folk.name: Tamsin Ree
folk.title: skill trainer
folk.line: Show me what your affinity already does. Then we will see what else it will learn.

folk.name: Edda Kell
folk.title: passage tickets
folk.line: The passage is owned. A ticket gets you in, and the meter runs while you are inside.

folk.name: Gorran Vell
folk.title: tempering yard
folk.line: A body is a blade. We fold it and beat it, and it comes back harder.

folk.name: Nils Ostry
folk.title: corpse retrieval
folk.line: We fetch what the passages keep. A flat fee by the star; nobody haggles over the dead.

folk.name: Ama Thresh
folk.title: renderer
folk.line: Bring me what you killed. Hide, fat and bone: nothing on a carcass is waste if you know where to cut.

folk.name: Joss Calder
folk.title: tanner
folk.line: A scraped hide goes in the vat and comes out leather. After that it is only cutting and stitching.

folk.name: Hesk Varga
folk.title: smith
folk.line: Scrap and flux and a hot fire. Strike while it is bright, and keep your hammer dry.
